# Project Documentation (canvas-refine-kit)

This document provides the core technical setup for the canvas-refine-kit project,
including TypeScript configuration, Vite build info, GitHub Actions deployment
pipeline, and IONOS Deploy Now integration.

It exists so Copilot and future contributors can quickly understand the project's
structure, build steps, and deployment process.

---

## 🚀 Tech Stack

- React + TypeScript  
- Vite build system  
- TailwindCSS  
- Framer Motion  
- GitHub Actions CI/CD  
- IONOS Deploy Now hosting
